newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 23.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$16.04 (-0.05)

The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd's Managing Director John Prescott said in a television interview on Sunday that he did not have a bullish view on copper prices. "We have to learn in these circumstances to live with lower copper prices some time and I'd regard any short term spikes as just that," he said. On Friday, BHP posted a 23 percent fall in first quarter net profit to A$287 million and said lower copper prices had cut profits by about A$150 million. The copper price fell US$36 a tonne to US$1,900 on Friday.

A senior executive of MIM Holdings Ltd has said the base metals miner expected to make a loss from copper operations at its Mt Isa mine in the current year, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Monday. "The copper number could be below the line this year if the copper price stays around where it is and the exchange rate is maintained at the current level," Phil Wright, general manager of Mt Isa operations, was quoted as saying by the newspaper.
TNT Ltd will use the money from the sale of its half share in Ansett Airlines to pay off debt in the short run.

Coles Myer Ltd said on Friday that deputy chairman Solomon Lew and his investment company, Premier Investments Ltd, had begun legal action against Coles Myer and the Australian Securities Commission to stop Coles reading transcripts relating to the Yannon transaction.
